paragraphs: EverArk sells cemetery management software for handling plots, maps, sales and memorials. It is aimed at cemetery managers who want to move operations onto online maps and digital records.

The software pairs plot and burial management with an ecommerce site for selling plots online. Administrative features named on the site include inventory management, sales tracking, customer organization, invoicing, maintenance control and recordkeeping. Old paper cemetery maps are converted into an interactive online map.

A second side of the product serves plot owners, who can set down a life story, add a family tree and administer a memorial, trust and funeral notice. The company offers a 30-day free trial with no credit card required. Beta pricing is listed at $12 per user each month. The EverArk trademark is owned by Eternal Legacy Company LLC.

quote.text: Convert your old paper cemetery maps to an online, interactive cemetery map experience
